title: Orange Cassidy vs. Moxley: fighting champion
summary: Cassidy’s championship endurance is tested by Moxley, then the challenger returns for a rematch as champion again.

chapters.title: Moxley ends Cassidy’s reign
chapters.result: Moxley defeats Cassidy for the International Championship.
chapters.context: Cassidy’s demanding defense schedule reaches a breaking point.

chapters.title: Cassidy wins the rematch
chapters.result: Cassidy retains the International title against Moxley.
chapters.context: The return match supplies a victory over the man who ended his first reign.
